title: Kissed Smoky Russian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and smoky Russian beef stew cooked in a claypot, featuring tender beef and vegetables in a rich beef stock, perfect for a cold winter's night. This low-glycemic-friendly dish is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in the claypot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the claypot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, tomato paste, and thyme to the claypot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef stock, carrots, and potatoes to the claypot and bring to a boil.
Cover the claypot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
